name: Magento MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to manage Adobe Commerce and Magento 2 instances through business-level tools for catalog, promotions, CMS, and SEO. It features secure OAuth 1.0 authentication, safety guardrails for bulk operations, and built-in diagnostic reports for store health.
